posts.author: Egar_Kresreb
posts.body:
I've been looking all over the place, and I can't seem to find what I'm looking for. In my game, I want to have this race of aliens that look basically like humans, but with red eyes, and skin in shades of purple, red, and light blue. The thing is, I want them to have armor and weaponry that looks sci-fi, and I'm having a lot of trouble finding that on static battlers. It's alright if they're wearing armor that covers their faces, so I guess the facial details don't matter a whole lot.
Sorry if this is rather specific, but if anybody can find some sci-fi armored static battlers, thanks! Oh, and I'm using RPG Maker MV, if that matters (I can't think why it would, but just in case).

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
No it is just hyper specific and a setting that does not really have much content so far, making it less likely that anyone ever made something like this - and battlers are pretty time consuming, so it is something that's not really picked up on a whim.
